function.arguments: {"index": 4, "status": "acted", "resolution": "The `channel` was not randomly assigned: the email campaign was deliberately targeted at loyal customers, who have a higher baseline conversion rate. The email group has a much higher proportion of loyal and returning customers than the paid_search group. A raw comparison of conversion rates would confound the channel effect with the customer segment effect. Therefore, we must adjust for `customer_segment` by computing the weighted average conversion rate per channel, using the segment size as weights. This ensures we isolate the true campaign effect rather than attributing differences due to targeting to the channel itself."}
function.name: resolve_finding
